title: Acquire workspace isolation through a host provider seam
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble asks branches for isolation without hard-coding worktrees or containers — the host provider supplies the mechanism. Accepts WalkingLabs L13 and Codex guidance[^wl-l13-workspace][^wl-codex-workspace].
implementation:
`WorkspaceIsolationProvider` and `InMemoryWorkspaceIsolationProvider` in `mechaharness.isolation.workspace_isolation` define the acquire/release capability seam.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
